patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within a generous maximum width, providing ample horizontal whitespace and a focused reading experience.
A single, highly versatile sans-serif font family (Inter) is used across all text, with variations in weight and size to establish clear hierarchy without introducing additional typefaces.
A minimalist color scheme relies heavily on a range of whites, greys, and blacks for backgrounds and text, with a single bright blue used exclusively for interactive elements and calls to action.
The top banner and main navigation transform into a compact, sticky header upon scroll, shrinking in height and changing its background color and text styling.
The hero section features a prominent, interactive search-like input field with dynamic, clickable suggestions, immediately engaging users with the product's core functionality.

technique_notes: The header employs CSS transitions or keyframes to smoothly animate its height, background color, and text color when the user scrolls past the initial viewport, creating a compact sticky navigation.
Major content sections are separated by significant vertical padding, creating an airy and uncluttered layout that guides the eye through distinct content blocks.
Feature cards and integration logos are arranged in flexible grid layouts that maintain consistent spacing and alignment, adapting to different content types and quantities.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display headings (~4-5x body text) with clear, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, input fields, and cards; pill-shaped or circular badges for certifications.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and balanced padding within content blocks, creating a breathable and uncluttered feel.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the interactive hero section, which immediately presents a search-like input field with dynamic suggestions, allowing users to instantly grasp and engage with the product's core automation capabilities. This direct, functional engagement sets it apart from typical static hero sections.
